exposure: Cervical lifting suture (CLS) in conjunction with the improved Hayman suture (CLS-Hayman)
cohort: 119 pregnant women diagnosed with pernicious placenta previa (PPP)
finding: The CLS-Hayman suture achieves the desired intraoperative hemostasis and also stands out for its better prevention of postpartum hemorrhage, better prognosis at follow-up, and lower complication rates.
